name: weighted sandbag romanian deadlift
description: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
